text.p: Stage Stores Inc said Bernard Fuchs has announced his retirement, resigning his positions as director and chairman of the board effective today.
Fuchs will continue to serve as a consultant to the company, Stage Stores said.
The company said Carl Tooker, president, chief executive officer and director of Stage Stores, has been elected chairman.
With Fuchs' resignation "for personal reasons", there are three vacant seats on the board of directors, the company said. Stage Stores said it is engaged in an active search to fill the three seats.
Fuchs, 70, began his career in retailing in 1941, and joined Palais Royal as chief operating officer in 1967.
He was appointed president and chief executive officer of Palais Royal in 1979, and elected chairman, president and chief executive of Specialty Retailers Inc, now part of Stage Stores, in 1988.
